verdict.stance: Overweight / Exclusive Dubai Regulated Power & Water Monopoly
verdict.summary: DEWA delivered record 9M26 revenue of AED 25.74bn (+3.3% YoY), AED 13.43bn EBITDA (52.2% margin), and AED 14.59bn operating cash flow against ~AED 44.7bn consolidated debt (~2.4x gross leverage). Exclusive Dubai franchise and 82% government ownership anchor investment-grade credit.

positives: 52.2% EBITDA margin and AED 14.59bn 9M26 CFO from exclusive Dubai power/water monopoly.
82% owned by Government of Dubai with visible population-driven demand growth.
Strategic Utilities market positioning in UAE supporting resilient operating cash generation.
negatives: High dividend payout commitments (AED 6.2bn/yr minimum) alongside clean energy/IPP capex.
Project-level debt consolidation across Hassyan/MBR solar JVs.
Exposure to UAE macro/FX volatility and sovereign spread widening cycles.
